events.title: Artistic Gymnastics World Championships 2026
events.note: The 2026 Artistic Gymnastics World Championships are taking place from October 17 to 25 in Rotterdam, Netherlands, featuring top Olympic and world champions, including the returning Rebeca Andrade. The event will determine world titles and offer qualification spots for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics through team competitions. Key contenders include Japan and the U.S., with notable absences such as Zhang Boheng, Donnell Whittenburg, and Brody Malone impacting medal predictions. Free live streaming is available via BBC iPlayer (UK), CBC Gem (Canada), and Eurovision Sport (select countries), with VPN services like NordVPN recommended for viewers abroad. Peacock Premium streams all finals live in the U.S., while qualifying rounds are accessible on Eurovision Sport. Daily events include team and all-around finals concluding with apparatus finals on the last two days. The Championships are hosted at Rotterdam Ahoy, promising high-stakes performances and potential new champions across events.
events.marketing_angle: Highlighting the return of top gymnasts and the quest for Olympic qualification.
events.why_selected: Major international sporting event with global appeal and potential for high engagement.
